title: Bilderberg Meetings: What Is Documented
summary: Annual invitation-only conference (~120–150 politicians, CEOs, central bankers, academics) under the Chatham House Rule since 1954. The organization itself publishes each year's agenda and participant list (2024 Madrid: 131 participants; 2025 Stockholm: 121). No primary source — minutes, directives, testimony — shows decision-making authority or a secret world government.
tldr: The Bilderberg Meeting's own site describes it as an annual informal forum since 1954 where ~130 European and North American leaders talk under Chatham House Rule — no agenda published, no resolutions, no votes, no policy statements.
ai_summary:
AI review of the official Bilderberg Meetings about page, read in full:
- Running since the inaugural 1954 meeting: an annual forum 'for informal discussions to foster dialogue between Europe and North America.'
- ~130 participants yearly: political leaders plus industry, finance, labour, academia and media; ~2/3 European, ~1/3 North American; ~1/3 politics/government.
- Chatham House Rule: participants may use information received but may not reveal speaker identity or affiliation; they attend as individuals, 'not bound by the conventions of their office.'
- 'No detailed agenda, no resolutions are proposed, no votes are taken, and no policy statements are issued.'
- The 72nd meeting took place April 9-12, 2026 in Washington, D.C. Record summary verified accurate against the document.
